correctness.rationale: For generator D*dxx, the gate-killed backward ODE system has two explicit positive decaying modes and reflecting/absorbing endpoint conditions H0'(0)=0, H1(0)=1; those uniquely give h0=p(Au-v)/B and h1=(pAu+qv)/B for strictly positive parameters. Gate resolvent U=r(rI-Q)^(-1) and strong Markov plus reset-clock memorylessness give K=U-h*U[1,:] for gate persistence. K is positive substochastic with row sums 1-h_i and det K=z(1-h1)>0; direct independent symbolic reduction verifies det(sI-K)=-pquv/(AB^2)<0 where s=pi K 1. This strictly interlaces s between two positive subunit eigenvalues for all positive physical parameters, making the two spectral weights strictly positive. Cayley-Hamilton yields P(N>=n)=pi K^n1=w+lambda+^n+w-lambda-^n for all n>=0. Positive distinct weights prove strict discrete tail log-convexity/decreasing hazard, and total variance yields strict excess 2w+w-(m+-m-)^2 over the geometric same-mean variance. This is an analytical proof; fresh symbolic checks and 9018 numerical comparisons support the identities only.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS, qualified by an important generic Markov-renewal/phase-type derivability risk. The exact same persistent closed-reflecting/open-absorbing gated Brownian model was developed in Mercado-Vásquez–Boyer (2021), but inspected results give absorption-time transforms and first moments rather than the count-marked two-geometric pmf and strict positive weights. Sunil et al. (2023) supply general count-and-cost renewal transforms for scalar renewal resetting; their renewal Eq. (3) assumes full process renewal after a reset, not a persistent gate. Bressloff (2020) reinitializes the gate; Bressloff (2023) obtains ungated scalar-geometric count. A later 2025/2026 blinking-target paper has a transparent rather than reflecting closed gate and does not state the count law. The claimed novel content is the positive spectral mixing and strict hazard/variance assertions in the fully persistent gate model, not first discovery of gate-persistent Brownian resetting or phase-type matrices. Semantic published-record search found no distinct covering prior, but a literature search is not a novelty proof.
residual_risks: An unindexed marked-count analysis of the exact persistent absorbing/reflecting gate system may already derive the two-geometric weights under another notation.

The direct model of Mercado-Vásquez–Boyer (2021) may imply the new count law after a nontrivial Markov-renewal extension and coefficient extraction; incremental novelty is more constrained than generic phase-type terminology suggests.
A general matrix-geometric/Markov-additive theorem could subsume interlacing under an additional monotone hazard condition, not located in the reviewed primary texts.
No exhaustive guarantee of publication priority beyond the searched sources and best-of-knowledge scope.

value.rationale: A persistent switching absorber is a natural stochastic search model where position resetting does not erase environmental memory. The count N is an operationally meaningful number of interventions, not merely mean absorption time. Exact positive mixture scales, strictly decreasing conditional absorption hazard, and strict excess dispersion distinguish the persistent gate quantitatively from ordinary renewal resetting and give an all-positive-parameter classification. The core sign identity is a motivated nontrivial structural statement rather than one arbitrary parameter experiment. Boundaries: excludes nonstationary initial gate, singular rates, drift, multiple gates, non-exponential reset clocks.

final_claim: For D,r,a,alpha,beta>0, half-line reflected Brownian with open-absorbing/closed-reflecting two-state independent gate left running through position-only Poisson resets and initially stationary gate has an exactly strict positive mixture of two distinct geometric reset-count laws, with explicit h,K, eigenvalues lambda+/- and positive weights. The reset-count tail is strictly log-convex, absorption-per-cycle hazard strictly decreases, and Var(N)>E[N](1+E[N]). Excludes zero/singular parameters, gate reinitialization and nonstationary initial gate.
limitations: Best-of-knowledge originality, not absolute historical-priority certification. Closest physical source 2021 already gives time-law transforms; old theory may implicitly permit a count-marked extension.
Near singular parameters the smaller mixture weight may become extremely small; naive floating point can erase strict interlacing although exact symbolic proof stays strict.
Finite 501-case and 9018-step checks are not infinite proofs; analytical determinant and eigenvalue argument handles universal scope.
